requires.label: Emergency or medically necessary care
requires.quote: You may be eligible for financial assistance for emergencies or medically necessary healthcare services...

application.quote: Eligible accounts include Gunnison Valley Hospital and Family Medicine Clinic (GVH & FMC) accounts with remaining balances. Accounts turning to bad debt will be considered as long as the complete application and supporting documentation are submitted prior to 180 days from the date of the initial account statement.

payment_plan.quote: Reasonable Payment Plan: A payment plan that is negotiated between GVH and FMC and the guarantor for any balances owed. The payment plan shall consider the patient, or guarantor's income and assets, the amount owed and any prior payments.

notes: The policy references Exhibit A (Financial Assistance Program Discount Scale) for specific discount percentages based on FPL and family size, but the exact percentages are not detailed in the provided text excerpt.
The policy mentions that non-urgent, elective or not medically necessary services may be excluded from or limited in the Financial Assistance Program.
Presumptive eligibility categories include homelessness, deceased with no estate, Medicaid eligible but not active (90-day lookback), mental incapacitation, and out-of-state Medicaid eligibility.
Duration of eligibility is 6 months from application date, requiring reapplication thereafter.
Application requires completion within 14 days to avoid denial, though eligibility consideration extends to 180 days from initial account statement.
The policy requires cooperation in applying for public programs; lack of cooperation may lead to denial of financial assistance.
Financial assistance determination occurs within 15 business days after submission of a completed application.
Collection actions may begin only after a final notice and at least 30 days have elapsed.
AGB percentage is 71% of gross charges for inpatient and outpatient services.
req_in_service_area may leave out a condition: policy limits assistance to residents of three specific counties, not just the hospital's service area

dropped.quote: Patient, or patient’s guarantor, has annual family income in excess of 400% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, but less than $200,000, and... The out-of-pocket, patient obligations resulting from medical services provided by GVH and FMC providers exceed 20% of annual family income.

The FAP will provide benefits as a last resort. All other payment options, including but not limited to private insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, CHP, third party Liability, and CICP must be explored for eligibility and secured where eligible prior to the application for financial assistance.
dropped.why: policy requires exploring other options but does not require having applied for public programs

dropped.claim: A patient with (not insured OR underinsured) AND (fpl_pct <= 250) gets 100% off
dropped.quote: Gunnison Valley, Hinsdale and Saguache Residents who are at or below 250% FPL will be required to apply for The Colorado Indigent Care Program (CICP)...
dropped.why: policy states patients at/below 250% FPL must apply for CICP, not that they get 100% off under FAP
